description: This file contains two simple functions: 'f', which takes two integers and returns 'y' if 'x' is zero or 'x' otherwise; and 'g', which decrements a size_t value until it reaches 34, then returns it. The functions are basic control structures demonstrating conditional statement and loop usage.

methods.name: int f(int x,int y)
methods.description: Returns 'y' if 'x' is zero; otherwise returns 'x'.

methods.name: int g(size_t u)
methods.description: Decrements the input 'u' until it is less than or equal to 34, then returns 'u'.
